test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight executives A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H of a company XYZ are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center (not necessarily in the same order). A is not the neighbour of B. Only one executive sits between F and G. Only two executives sit between E and H. D is third to the right of B and is the immediate neighbour of H. A sits second to the right of C. F is the neighbour of A.

What is the position of F with respect to H?

options.text: F is second to the left of H
F is third to the left of H
F is fourth to the left of H
F is to the immediate left of H

solution:
**Given:** Eight executives A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H of a company XYZ are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center.

1) D is third to the right of B and is the immediate neighbour of H. 

2) Only two executives sit between E and H. 

As the positions of E and H are not known yet, therefore there are four possible cases.

4) F is the neighbour of A.

5) A is not the neighbour of B.

As there is no possible position for G in case 2 and case 4, therefore are eliminated.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer
